curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach defensive driving, choices in a forced crash, and each phase of a traffic stop.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each defensive rule and stop step.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario questions on a traffic stop and on choosing what to hit.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover what drivers must do after a crash, who reports it, hit-and-run penalties, first aid and shock care.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each duty, report rule and penalty.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on crash duties, reporting deadlines and penalties.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach how to avoid rear-end crashes, handle a breakdown, and brake when traction is lost.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each step with contrasts on plain and anti-lock braking.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on breakdown steps and emergency braking.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover car fires, jammed pedals, overcorrection, dark signals, pavement drops and skids.
Teach stalls on tracks, sinking cars, blowouts, wrong-way drivers and wet brakes.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each emergency with its key number.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on train stalls, sinking cars and blowouts.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec09-m01..sec09-m05; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact

sequencing.rule: module order, then component facts before synthesis nodes
